title: Founding Strategy & Operations
description_clean: Alassio recherche son (sa) prochain(e) Founding Strategy & Operations !  Missions 🏗️ Alassio en quelques motsEn France, la paie et le social comptent parmi les fonctions les plus réglementées qui soient. Entre inflation réglementaire et évolutions légales et conventionnelles incessantes, la conformité est devenue un véritable fardeau pour les cabinets de paie et les services RH :ce fardeau les empêche de se consacrer à ce qui compte vraiment, le conseil et l'accompagnement des salariés, qui en subissent donc eux aussi le poids ;c'est aussi l'un des métiers où l'attrition est la plus forte en France, notamment parce que 60 % du temps des gestionnaires de paie est encore consacré à de la saisie ou à de la relecture manuelle.Pourtant, des solutions technologiques majeures existent : l'IA permet en particulier d'automatiser une très grande partie des tâches les plus pénibles et de valoriser les données sociales. Mais le secteur reste largement à l'écart de cette révolution, et le problème n'est pas seulement réglementaire : le marché était verrouillé par des éditeurs historiques vieillissants, difficiles à quitter faute d'alternative crédible et de moyens pour migrer efficacement. Là aussi, l'IA fait voler ces barrières en éclats et ouvre la voie à une vague d'innovation attendue depuis des décennies.C'est pour y répondre qu'Alassio construit la plateforme de paie et de gestion RH moderne qui manquait à ce marché, au service des cabinets et de leurs clients TPE/PME. Notre ambition est de développer en un temps record :une plateforme collaborative et ouverte, qui s'intègre nativement aux outils des cabinets et de leurs clients, respecte leurs habitudes de travail et fluidifie les échanges entre gestionnaires de paie et entreprises ;l'automatisation de la tenue administrative : collecte des données, paramétrage des évolutions légales et des règles propres à chaque entreprise, génération automatique des rapports et formulaires, traçabilité juridique dynamique et en temps réel, etc. ;la valorisation des données de paie et sociales, pour offrir un conseil social à 360° et enfin répondre efficacement à l'ensemble des attentes des salariés, qui se sont de surcroît largement amplifiées depuis le Covid : gestion contractuelle, pilotage de la masse salariale, avantages salariés, fidélisation des talents, mutuelle…L'objectif : devenir le « People OS » sur lequel les cabinets et leurs clients TPE/PME s'appuient pour gérer l'intégralité de leurs problématiques paie et RH. 🚀 Tes responsabilitésTa mission est de concevoir et faire vivre les systèmes de fonctionnement d'Alassio. Concrètement, tu identifies partout dans l'entreprise ce qui empêche les équipes de travailler à l'échelle (un process défaillant ou absent, un passage de relais flou, une information introuvable, une tâche répétitive que personne n'a pris le temps d'automatiser) et tu le résous de bout en bout : un diagnostic précis, puis un cahier des charges documenté et actionnable, puis l'accompagnement de sa mise en œuvre jusqu'à son adoption effective par les équipes. Une solution que personne n'utilise n'est pas une solution.Tes leviers sont aussi bien managériaux (formalisme interne, rituels, répartition des responsabilités) que produit et techniques (modèle de données, outillage, automatisation des flux de travail), avec un parti pris constant : « Just build it ». Tu mettras en place, avec les équipes concernées, des solutions actionnables et des systèmes qui tournent. 🧭 Tes premiers chantiersPour te donner une idée concrète, voici le type de chantiers que tu pourrais mener dans tes six premiers mois :Bâtir un réseau national de formateurs et d'intégrateurs certifiés, pour permettre aux cabinets de se former partout en France sans saturer nos équipes à chaque pic de déploiement : modèle économique et tarification, maillage du territoire avec les Sales, parcours de certification et suivi qualité avec l'équipe DnA (Déploiement & Accompagnement), cadre contractuel, et circuit de remontée des demandes des cabinets vers le support et le Product. En bref, tu contribueras à mettre sur pied une place de marché d'intégrateurs et de formateurs Alassio.Fluidifier le parcours d'un cabinet, de la signature à la production : formaliser les passages de relais entre les squads Sales, DnA, Métier & Juridique et Tech (ce qui est transmis, dans quel outil, dans quel délai, et qui tranche en cas de blocage). Ce travail se traduit par la mise en place de workflows au sein de Bedrock, notre OS interne : il rend l'ensemble du contexte d'Alassio interrogeable et permet de transformer quasi instantanément une solution que tu as formalisée en gain concret pour toute l'équipe.Améliorer en profondeur, en coordination étroite avec l'AI Engineer, notre OS Bedrock pour en faire le réflexe par défaut de toutes les équipes : identifier les cas d'usage transverses à plus fort impact, structurer le contexte métier qui alimente l'OS, travailler sur l'hébergement et la dimension collaborative, mettre en place des workflows d'agents déclenchés par événement, tenir à jour le catalogue des commandes, et mettre en place le suivi qui mesure la performance et l'adoption.  Profil recherché 🌱 ExpérienceAu moins 2 description_clean: Product Design Director - Patient (x/f/m)The opportunityDoctolib is a mission-driven healthcare technology company, founded in Paris in 2013. Today, nearly 3,000 people work across Europe to transform the way healthcare is delivered and experienced.More than 500,000 healthcare professionals use Doctolib’s solutions, and the patient app is used by approximately 90 million people across Europe.For patients, Doctolib began as a simple way to find a healthcare professional and book an appointment. We are now building something much more ambitious: an AI-powered Health Companion that helps people navigate care, understand their health and take the right next step throughout their health journey.This means moving beyond a primarily transactional product towards an experience that supports patients before, during and after care, through access to care, health information, patient data, messaging, recommendations, care plans and AI-powered assistance.We are looking for a Product Design Director to help define what this next generation of patient experience should look and feel like.What you will build and leadAs Product Design Director, Patient, you will own the design vision and quality bar for Doctolib’s patient experience. You will report to our VP Design and work closely with the Product, Engineering, Medical, Data and Business leadership teams. Your scope will cover the full patient journey, including:access to care, search and booking;patient messaging and teleconsultation;the Patient Health Record and patient context;the app homepage and daily health experience;health content and prevention;recommendations, reminders and care plans;new patient services and subscription experiences;conversational and AI-powered experiences.The current team includes six Senior Product Designers and one Senior Content Designer. You will lead, coach and develop this team while shaping the organisation and operating model needed to support the next phase of the Patient product.Your mandateYou will:Define and drive the design vision for the Patient stream, from a high-traffic booking experience to a trusted Health Companion used throughout the health journey.Bridge two equally important challenges: continuing to improve the core access-to-care experience while creating new reasons for patients to return beyond booking.Raise the quality bar for product design, interaction design and content across the patient experience.Stay close enough to the product and the craft to make high-quality design decisions, not only set direction from a distance.Shape AI-native experiences that are clear, useful and trustworthy, including recommendations, conversational interfaces and next-best actions.Establish strong design principles for transparency, explainability, uncertainty, user control and safe escalation in a healthcare context.Build a high-performing design organisation, including hiring, coaching, talent development and second-line leadership.Create effective ways of working across Engineering and Medical;developed a clear operating model and growth plan for the Patient Design organisation;helped Doctolib increase the value and relevance of the patient experience beyond appointment booking.What we are looking forYou are likely to bring:Significant experience leading Product Design, 10+ years in product design including 3+ years in people leadership..Experience in a consumer product organisation, ideally one used by millions of people.A track record of designing and scaling products across multiple markets, with an understanding of localisation, cultural differences and the balance between global consistency and local relevance.Experience managing at least five Product Designers, ideally a larger organisation including senior individual contributors and managers.Strong product design craft and creative judgement. title: System Performance Intern
description_clean: About Pangea Propulsion:We are a company dedicated to developing advanced propulsion systems for the space industry based on three key principles: high efficiency, sustainability, and reusability. We are revolutionizing the space industry with ground-breaking innovations that allow us to offer the best performance to cost propulsion systems.Our goal is to be the propulsion provider for the next generation of spacecraft, which is essential to meet demands and compete in the booming space market of the next decade.We are a passionate, multicultural, and multidisciplinary team pushing the boundaries of what is possible in space propulsion technology.We have already made history by successfully testing the world's first 3D-printed Methalox Aerospike engine, marking a significant milestone for the space industry.We are looking for talented professionals to join our international teams in Barcelona and Toulouse. We want to be a key player in improving diversity in the Aerospace sector as, in Pangea, we believe that diversity (gender, age, race, sexual orientation, beliefs, disability, culture, etc.) is a key to success. Within Pangea, everyone can grow with the same opportunities. We encourage you to apply. Individually we are different, but together we are an amazing team!We are looking for a System Performance Intern in Toulouse.About the role:We are seeking a motivated System Performance Intern to join our System Performance team in Toulouse. During this six-month internship, you will support system-level design, modelling and performance analysis activities for Kronos full-flow staged-combustion rocket engines.You will work closely with System Performance engineers and specialists in combustion, fluidics, turbomachinery and other disciplines to connect engine requirements and design choices with cycle modelling, subsystem characteristics and overall engine performance. You will be involved in the development and execution of engine models, investigating nominal, throttled and off-nominal operating conditions, and assessing how evolving subsystem designs influence the complete propulsion system. The work will include sensitivity studies, design trade-offs and support to the definition of operating and control strategies.This internship requires strong fundamentals in thermodynamics and fluid mechanics, an understanding of liquid rocket-engine cycles, and the ability to interpret numerical results critically rather than treating simulation tools as black boxes. You will contribute to transient analyses covering start-up, throttling and shutdown, and consolidate results into engineering conclusions, performance maps, operating envelopes, subsystem requirements and technical documentation for design reviews.Key Responsibilities:· Develop, modify and execute system-level engine models in EcosimPro/ESPSS.· Analyse nominal operating points and engine operational envelopes, including throttled and off-nominal conditions.· Support engine-cycle optimisation and system-level design trade-offs.· Perform sensitivity studies on key design and operational parameters.· Translate simulation results into engineering conclusions, performance maps, operating envelopes and subsystem requirements.· Support preparation and maintenance of System Performance documentation for project design reviews.· Work with combustion, fluidics, turbomachinery and other disciplines to integrate evolving subsystem designs into the system model.What you need to be successful:· MSc in Aerospace Engineering or equivalent, preferably with a background in propulsion, fluid mechanics, thermodynamics, energy systems or numerical modelling.· Experience with numerical modelling and engineering analysis through academic or professional projects.· Strong fundamentals in thermodynamics, fluid mechanics and heat transfer.· Understanding of liquid rocket propulsion and the fundamental operation of rocket-engine cycles.· Ability to analyse coupled engineering systems and critically interpret simulation results.· Basic programming or engineering scripting capability, preferably Python and/or MATLAB.Soft Skills:· Strong analytical problem-solving skills.· Ability to communicate technical results clearly in English through documentation and presentations.· You are expected to work in a structured and analytical manner, communicate your results clearly, and progressively take ownership of defined modelling and analysis tasks while receiving guidance from experienced engineers.Other useful skills:· Experience with EcosimPro/ESPSS or another 0D/1D system-simulation environment.· Knowledge of staged-combustion or full-flow staged-combustion rocket-engine cycles.· Understanding of turbopumps, turbines, pre-burners, combustion chambers, regenerative cooling circuits, valves and feed systems.· Experience with transient simulation, controls or system dynamics.· Experience with sensitivity analysis, uncertainty propagation or Monte Carlo methods.· Experience processing engineering data using Python or MATLAB.· Familiarity with Git/version control and structured engineering-development processes.· A university project, thesis or previous internship involving propulsion-system modelling.Not hitting every requirement? You might just be the ideal candidate for this position or other opportunities within our organization.Pangea Propulsion is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity and inclusion. We consider all applications without discrimination on any legally protected grounds. We welcome applications from persons with disabilities and we can provide reasonable accommodations throughout the recruitment process and in the workplace.More about us…We are an international and very multicultural team. We enjoy having diverse views to enrich the debate and take better decisions.Passion for growth: we are passionate about space and about being pioneers; also, we value personal and organizational growth aiming to a constant improvement.Sustainability: because a long-term vision and strategy is not possible if sustainability is not in the team’s core values.Daring: we do things that sometimes seem impossible, but we always go the extra mile to find a path to do them and we are ready to take the necessary risks to achieve our goals.If this sounds good to you and you want to join the New Space revolution, we really want to meet you!Find Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

description_clean:
We're building the future of urban stays. One city at a time.
Homaris widmet sich einer der drängendsten Herausforderungen moderner Städte: Menschen aus aller Welt brauchen Orte, an denen sie leben, arbeiten und sich zuhause fühlen können. Wir entwickeln und betreiben vollständig digitalisierte Serviced Apartments in den großen Städten Deutschlands. Unser nächster Schritt: Europa und darüber hinaus.
Mit dem nanopartment® verfolgen wir eine Produktvision, die modernes Wohnen auf Zeit neu denkt – auf kleinstmöglichem Raum.
Unser Umsatz verdreifacht sich innerhalb von zwei Jahren – organisch und aus eigener Kraft. Ohne Venture Capital. Ohne Exit-Strategie. Wir denken langfristig und bauen unser Unternehmen konsequent danach auf.
Außergewöhnliche Menschen machen diese Entwicklung möglich. Jetzt suchen wir eine weitere Person, die diesen Weg mit uns gestaltet.
Your Role
Du führst die operativen Fäden unserer digitalen Gästebetreuung. Aus dem Headoffice in Berlin arbeitest du mit dem Guest Service Supervisor Team und bist die zentrale Ansprechperson für unsere weltweiten Guest Service Agents. Du sorgst dafür, dass Gäste eine verlässliche Betreuung erleben, und hältst den Rücken frei für Teams, die täglich mit ihnen sprechen. Am Steuer unserer digitalen Rezeption schaffst du im Hintergrund den reibungslosen Ablauf jedes Aufenthalts.
What You'll Do
Betrieb. Du unterstützt das Guest Service Team im Tagesgeschäft und sorgst dafür, dass unsere Apartments aus dem Hintergrund reibungslos laufen.  
Qualität. Du entwickelst neue Qualitätskonzepte, kontrollierst die Einhaltung unserer Standards in der Gästekommunikation und schulst die Agents fortlaufend.  
Kommunikation. Du entwirfst Nachrichtenvorlagen, mit denen Gäste verlässlich, persönlich und im richtigen Ton erreicht werden.  
Second Level. Du bist die Ansprechperson für Agents, wenn es komplex wird, und übernimmst die Lösung, wenn es darauf ankommt.  
Onboarding. Du begleitest die Einarbeitung neuer Kolleg:innen und die Weiterbildung bestehender Teammitglieder.  
Vertretung. Du vertrittst die Teamlead Guest Service bei Abwesenheit und behältst dann das gesamte Team im Blick.  
Schnittstelle. Du stimmst dich eng mit internen Abteilungen und externen Dienstleistern ab, als verlässlicher Partner, der Lösungen zu Ende denkt.
What Makes You a Fit
Service mit Haltung. Du hast einen starken Dienstleistungsgedanken und dich stört es nicht, zu unterschiedlichen Tageszeiten sowie in geregelten Abständen am Wochenende im Dienst zu sein.  
Erfahrung. Du bringst Berufserfahrung als Reservierungsmitarbeiter:in, Reservation Agent oder Manager:in, Call Center Agent, Rezeptionist:in oder aus einer anderen serviceorientierten Branche mit.  
Organisation. Du organisierst und koordinierst souverän und denkst lösungsorientiert.  
Kommunikationsstärke. Du findest schnell Zugang zu unterschiedlichen Persönlichkeiten und vermittelst Standpunkte, Ideen und Lösungen klar.  
Digitale Werkzeuge. Du kommst mit Software und digitalen Lösungen im Alltag mühelos zurecht. Erfahrung mit Buchungsplattformen sowie den Property-Management-Systemen Apaleo oder Guesty ist ein Plus.  
Sprachen. Du beherrschst Deutsch und Englisch fließend in Wort und Schrift (jeweils C1).  
Digitale Neugier. Du erkennst Potenziale in neuen Tools und bist begeistert davon, wie KI deinen Arbeitsalltag effizienter macht.
The Environment
Homaris ist konsequent langfristig ausgerichtet. Wir investieren nicht in kurzfristiges Wachstum mit dem Ziel, schnell zu verkaufen. Wir bauen etwas Nachhaltiges und Substanzielles auf – und suchen Menschen, die diesen Weg gemeinsam mit uns gehen und langfristig Verantwortung übernehmen wollen.  
Das Tempo ist hoch. Die Herausforderungen sind anspruchsvoll und unmittelbar. Unser Team ist bewusst klein gehalten, sodass jede Person einen spürbaren Beitrag leistet.  
Wir nehmen uns nicht immer ausreichend Zeit, unsere Erfolge sichtbar zu machen und gemeinsam zu feiern. Daran arbeiten wir – und freuen uns, wenn du uns dabei unterstützt.
What We Offer
Wir definieren unsere Level nicht anhand von Jobtiteln oder Berufsjahren, sondern danach, welche Themen du eigenständig verantwortest und für welche Entscheidungen du einstehst.  
Darüber hinaus haben wir uns intensiv damit auseinandergesetzt, was Menschen brauchen, um ihre beste Arbeit zu leisten und gleichzeitig gut zu leben. Daraus ist ein Leistungspaket entstanden, das genau das widerspiegelt: Gesundheit, Mobilität, persönliche Entwicklung, Flexibilität und einige besondere Vorteile, die das Arbeiten in der Reise- und Hospitality-Branche mit sich bringt. Vieles ist bereits dabei.  
Die Details stellen wir dir gerne im persönlichen Gespräch vor.
Next Steps

Découvrez un lieu où vos compétences seront valorisées et où vous pourrez façonner l'avenir de la gestion financière. Notre visionNotre ambition est de devenir le logiciel de pilotage financier préféré des PMEs européennes.Nous aidons les entrepreneurs à se débarrasser des tâches chronophages liées à la comptabilité et à la finance, tout en leur donnant accès à des informations financières clés pour les aider à prendre les meilleures décisions pour leur entreprise.Parallèlement, nous aidons les cabinets d'expertise-comptable, en leur permettant de passer moins de temps sur des tâches redondantes et répétitives, et plus de temps sur la partie conseil et accompagnement de leurs clients. À propos de PennylanePennylane est une des FinTech à la plus forte croissance en France, et souhaite bientôt adresser le marché européen. En 5 ans d'existence, nous sommes parvenus à :💻 Nous positionner sur le marché comme un éditeur de solution de comptabilité et de gestion financière innovant💰 Lever un total de 400 millions d'euros, auprès d'investisseurs de renom, dont Sequoïa, le fonds phare de la Silicon Valley, connu pour avoir soutenu Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal et bien d'autres à leur début👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Passer de 7 cofondateurs à une équipe de 1000 collaborateurs, avec une note moyenne de 4,9/5 sur Glassdoor et 94% des évaluateurs Glassdoor qui recommanderaient PL à leurs proches!🌍 Construire une équipe internationale composée de collaborateurs issus de 25 pays différents, avec une culture du télétravail très flexible🤝 Gagner la confiance de milliers d'utilisateurs et obtenir d'excellents retours🚀 Déjà plus de 900,000 TPE/PME et plus de 6000 cabinets d’expertise-comptable utilisent Pennylane en France !   Pourquoi ce rôle est-il si important chez nous ? En tant que Spécialiste Support Services Financiers, tu te positionnes comme un expert métier et plateforme.Tu es l'interlocuteur privilégié de notre base clients qui a choisi Pennylane comme logiciel central de leur gestion comptable et financière.Tu te trouves donc au cœur de l'expérience client 360 et fais profiter les clients et leurs comptables de la pleine puissance de Pennylane au service de leur croissance.  Comment vas-tu contribuer au projet ? En tant que membre de l'équipe Support applicatif et technique, tu es le point de relais central entre nos clients Dirigeants, leurs Comptables internalisés et l'équipe Support. Tu es en contact quotidien avec les utilisateurs et cherches à comprendre les problèmes qu'ils rencontrent.Après investigation, ton but est d'apporter une réponse ou solution à ton interlocuteur, ou quand cela est nécessaire, d'escalader le problème aux équipes techniques.  Quelles seront tes missions au quotidien ? 3 premiers mois :- Tu intègres la CSM Academy et tu te formes en continu sur le produit et les rouages de l'équipe.- Tu apprends tout ce qu'il faut savoir sur notre entreprise, notre vision, et nos différents départements.- Tu apprends à identifier toutes les parties prenantes et à collaborer efficacement au sein de ton équipe, ainsi qu'avec les différents départements.- Tu commences à répondre à des demandes des clients liées à nos services financiers : tu réceptionnes les demandes, les qualifies et apportes des réponses rapides et impactantes. 4 à 6 mois :- Tu gagnes en autonomie et prends intégralement les commandes de ton portefeuille client.- Tu commences à gérer des demandes clients de plus en plus complexes.- Tu contribues à la création et à l’actualisation des supports d’aide à disposition du client afin de développer leur autonomie.- Tu partages à tes collègues tes connaissances comptables et ton expérience "terrain".- Tu portes la voix et l’usage du client et partages aux équipes produit des retours construits. Et ensuite... :- Tu deviens un expert produit et fais gagner en efficacité ton équipe en identifiant les axes d'amélioration- Tu prends le contrôle et mènes au succès des projets qui te tiennent à cœur et qui te font progresser  Profil recherché - Expérience de plusieurs années au sein d’une “néo-banque”, d’une banque en ligne ou d’une banque traditionnelle.- Excellente compréhension du système bancaire.- Expérience précédente en support B2B requise.- À l’aise avec des échanges téléphoniques quotidiens avec les clients.- Un travail en direct avec le dirigeant est un plus (conseil interne par exemple).- Disponible pour des horaires roulants et adaptés aux besoins des clients.- Un intérêt pour la technologie est un plus avec notamment la connaissance des produits des Fintech actuelles du marché. Poste ouvert au télétravail avec 2 jours de déplacements à Paris au sein de nos locaux par mois (frais pris en charge).  Process de recrutement - Entretien en visio avec Simon Peraldo - Senior Recruiter (30 min)- Entretien en visio avec Vincent Lambert - Responsable de l’équipe (1h)- Dernier échange visio avec Johan Chrzanosvski - Head of Customer Care, et Maxime Leclercq - Head of Financial Services (45 min)  🎁 Ce que l’on peut t'offrir :🏥 Une mutuelle parmi les meilleures sur le marché (Alan Blue et Alan Mind)🍜 Des tickets restaurants (Carte Swile)🏝 Entre 6 et 12 jours de RTT supplémentaires aux 5 semaines de congés payés🇬🇧 La possibilité de perfectionner ton anglais grâce à Busuu🧑‍💻 Un budget dédié chaque mois pour tous nos Pennylaners, favorisant le travail depuis la maison ou en espace de coworking🏢 Une facilité d’accès à nos bureaux, situés à quelques minutes de Saint Lazare en plein cœur de Paris💵 Une enveloppe de BSPCE🏃‍♀️ Un accès à 8000 salles de sport partout en France et plus de 300 activités de bien-être via notre partenaire Gymlib💻 Un Mac🎉 Nous pratiquons de nombreux sports ensemble et avons à cœur de nous réunir régulièrement autour d’événements d’entreprise tels que les Tech Days (qui permettent aux Pennylaners en remote de se réunir tous les 3 mois) ou notre séminaire d’entreprise qui a lieu une fois par an, et qui favorise de grands moments de cohésion pour toutes et tous. Pour t'épanouir chez Pennylane, il faudra:-Parler anglais (le niveau est évalué et apprécié en fonction du département auquel tu postules)-Apprécier travailler dans un environnement en changement constant-Faire de la collaboration une priorité au sein de son équipe ou avec d'autres parties prenantes-Avoir un recul suffisant pour prioriser les actions à fort impact business dans son activité quotidienne. Nous savons que certaines personnes sont moins susceptibles de postuler que d'autres si elles estiment ne pas remplir l'intégralité des critères.Si tu hésites, nous t'encourageons à postuler quand même : qui sait, cela pourrait être le début d'une collaboration significative et durable ! Information importante à destination des candidat(e)sLes tentatives d’arnaque au recrutement sont en hausse. Nous vous invitons à rester vigilant(e) lors de vos échanges. Candidature uniquement via nos canaux officiels : postulez exclusivement via nos offres publiées sur nos supports officiels (site carrière, pages officielles partenaires).Vérifiez systématiquement l’adresse e-mail de l’expéditeur : nos communications sont envoyées depuis des adresses professionnelles avec les domaine @pennylane.com ou ----- .Nous ne vous demanderons jamais de paiement, ni d’informations financières (coordonnées bancaires, paiement pour un entretien, achat de matériel, etc.) dans le cadre du recrutement.Si une telle demande vous est faite, il s’agit d’une fraude. Nous vous invitons à ne pas répondre et à nous le signaler immédiatement." Encourageant la diversité, équité et inclusion sous toutes ses formes, Pennylane offre un environnement de travail inclusif, bienveillant et propice à l’épanouissement, dans nos bureaux et en remote. Nous nous engageons à fournir les mêmes chances à tous nos candidats, indépendamment de leurs origines sociales et ethniques, genres, religions, orientations sexuelles ou handicaps.🇫🇷 Données personnelles Pennylane traite vos données pour gérer votre candidature et évaluer votre adéquation au poste. Si votre candidature n’aboutit pas, vos données peuvent être conservées 2 ans à compter de notre dernier échange ou de la clôture du recrutement afin de constituer & gérer un vivier de candidats. Vous pouvez vous opposer à tout moment et demander la suppression de vos données en écrivant à :  Notre data policy🇬🇧 Personal Data Pennylane processes your data to manage your application and assess your suitability for the position. If your application is unsuccessful, your data may be retained for 2 years from our last exchange or the closing of the recruitment process, in order to build and manage a candidate pool. You may object at any time and request the deletion of your data by writing to Learn more🇩🇪 Personenbezogene Daten Pennylane verarbeitet Ihre Daten, um Ihre Bewerbung zu bearbeiten und Ihre Eignung für die Stelle zu beurteilen. Sollte Ihre Bewerbung nicht erfolgreich sein, können Ihre Daten bis zu 2 Jahre ab unserem letzten Austausch oder dem Abschluss des Rekrutierungsverfahrens gespeichert werden, um einen Kandidatenpool aufzubauen und zu verwalten. Sie können jederzeit Widerspruch einlegen und die Löschung Ihrer Daten beantragen, indem Sie an Mehr erfahren🇪🇸 Datos personalesPennylane trata sus datos para gestionar su candidatura y evaluar su idoneidad para el puesto. En caso de que su candidatura no sea seleccionada, sus datos podrán conservarse hasta 2 años a partir de nuestro último contacto o de la finalización del proceso de selección, con el fin de constituir y gestionar una reserva de candidatos. Puede oponerse en cualquier momento y solicitar la eliminación de sus datos escribiendo a Más informaciónFind Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

The patient calls, the AI books the appointment or answers the question, and the medical secretaries keep their time for the cases where a human is really needed.$20M raised, with the founders of Alan and Datadog as investorsClose to 1 million calls a month going through the platformOpening the US marketThe problemEvery medical practice runs on software that holds its calendar and its patients. There are dozens of different ones. Most were built twenty years ago and some have no API at all. To book an appointment during a call, our AI agent has to read and write in that software in real time, while the patient waits on the line. In the US, we are opening the dental software ecosystem, with the compliance work that comes with it (HIPAA, SOC2).There is no product manager on this scope. You would be the one deciding.What you will ownThe architecture of our booking layer. Today it is code written provider by provider, under pressure, partly in Python. It is becoming one unified layer in TypeScript that handles the rules of each medical centre, where adding a new software takes days, not weeks.Speed and reliability at close to 1M calls a month. A call to a clinic software can take several seconds, and the patient cannot wait. You decide how we detect a booking failure in a clinic within 24 hours and what a healthy integration looks like.The roadmap of your scope. You decide which software we connect first, with the sales, ops and support teams and the clinics themselves, and you prove it worked with a number: bookings that go through, failures caught, clinics signed.The relationship with the software vendors, in France and in the US. Agents in every workflow, Claude Max provided. A migration estimated at 3 months was done in 2 weeks.Close to the field. You talk every day with the ops team that deploys clinics, the support team that hears when something breaks and, when it matters, the clinics and the software vendors themselves.StackTypeScript everywhere (Node, monorepo), PostgreSQL, REST and SOAP APIs from software vendors. We are migrating our last Python services to TypeScript over the coming months.Who does well here6 to 10 years building products in production, mostly in startups that were growing fast, with at least one place where you stayed long enough to see your system live in the long run.You have built something that mattered: an early engineer at a startup that took off, a system you launched that real users depended on. Kundensicht, bevor sie live gehen.🏗️ Den Bereich aufbauenDu schreibst die Playbooks für Onboarding, Rollout, Support und Upsell – und automatisierst sie, wo immer es geht.Du entwickelst und betreibst das mit Zahlen belegenDeutsch auf C2-Niveau und sicheres EnglischStandort München oder Bereitschaft, dauerhaft von hier aus zu arbeitenPluspunkteDu hast selbst schon aktiv entwickelt – eigene Engineering-Team kommtDu kennst Teile unseres Stacks (TypeScript, React, Supabase) schon aus eigenen ProjektenDu hast schon in der Baubranche gearbeitet oder hast einen engen Bezug zu ihrDu hast bereits in einem schnell wachsenden Early-Stage-Startup gearbeitet und weißt, wie es sich anfühlt, wenn es noch kein Playbook gibtDu hast schon einmal einen Bereich oder Prozess von null aufgebautWie du arbeitestAI-native: Du nutzt KI reflexhaft, nicht gelegentlich. Ä.), testest neue Modelle sofort und weißt, was taugt.Systems Thinker: Du siehst das System hinter dem einzelnen Kunden. Beim zweiten Mal baust du den Prozess, der das manuelle Lösen überflüssig macht – und dokumentierst ihn für die nächste Person.Technische Tiefe: Du prüfst Daten, verfolgst Flows, liest Logs und grenzt Probleme sauber ein – und behebst sie, wo es geht, selbst mit KI-Tools. title: Working Student Communications (f/m/d)
description_clean: 01 · Why this role existsThis year, RIZM has created unprecedented savings at our customers. We just aren't telling anyone. If you love telling stories, let's talk.RIZMO is our Agentic Energy Manager: an AI agent that helps industrial companies optimize their energy use and cut costs. We work with BMW, Stellantis, Boehringer Ingelheim and Bitburger. Right now, those success stories stay inside the project team. You'll change that.02 · What you'll doYou'll be our communications all-rounder and work directly with the founders and the go-to-market team.Storytelling: Turn customer projects, technology and energy-market developments into stories that a CFO or plant manager reads to the end.Video: Make short videos about customer projects and RIZMO, from concept and editing through to sign-off with the customer.PR: Pitch stories to business and trade media (Handelsblatt, manager magazin and others), write press releases and prepare interviews.LinkedIn: Plan and write content for our company page, and help the founders and GTM team with their own posts. We don't do Instagram, TikTok or blogs. Our audience is on LinkedIn and reads Handelsblatt.Events: Prepare our presence at trade fairs like E-world and Hannover Messe. That covers materials, booking meetings in advance and following up with the contacts we make.B2B marketing for long sales cycles: Our deals take months and involve many decision-makers. You'll build case studies and one-pagers that support a deal from first contact to signature.03 · What you bringStudent status: You're enrolled at a university. Your field doesn't matter (communications, journalism, business, industrial engineering, energy …) as long as you write well.Languages: Excellent German and good English.Curiosity: Energy, industry and AI interest you. We'll teach you the technical side.Ownership: You work independently, ask when something is unclear, and deliver.Nice to have: Experience with video editing, PR or event organization.Availability: 20 hours per week on-site in Münster or Munich, for at least 6 months, ideally longer.04 · What we offerPay: €16 per hour.Real ownership: From day one, you'll help build our communications from the ground up.Short paths: A direct line to the founders and fast decisions.Stories worth telling: Customers everyone knows.05 · How to applyYou love telling stories? Then tell us two. title: Sales Manager (m/w/d) – Stadtwerke & Industrie | Süddeutschland
description_clean: Dein Job für sauberere Luft. Werde Emission Partner.Technik aus dem Saterland. Wirkung weit darüber hinaus.In der Gemeinde Saterland entwickeln und produzieren wir Technologien, die Schadstoffemissionen reduzieren. Unsere Katalysatoren und Systeme kommen dort zum Einsatz, wo Abgase zuverlässig gereinigt und Emissionsgrenzwerte eingehalten werden müssen.Dabei entwickeln wir uns kontinuierlich weiter und erschließen neue Anwendungsfelder für unsere Technologien. Gerade bei Stadtwerken und Industrieunternehmen entstehen neue Anforderungen und damit neue Möglichkeiten für moderne Lösungen zur Abgasnachbehandlung.Und genau hier kommst du ins Spiel.Als Sales Manager für Süddeutschland entwickelst du unser Geschäft mit Stadtwerken und Industriekunden weiter. Du identifizierst Marktpotenziale, gewinnst neue Kunden, entwickelst bestehende Key Accounts und bringst unsere technischen Lösungen mit den Anforderungen unserer Kunden zusammen.Du möchtest nicht einfach ein bestehendes Vertriebsgebiet verwalten, sondern Marktpotenziale erschließen, Kundenbeziehungen aufbauen und ein Geschäftsfeld aktiv weiterentwickeln? Dann werde Emission Partner.Was du bei uns bewirkstDu bringst unsere Technologie dorthin, wo Emissionen entstehen und Lösungen gebraucht werden.In deiner Region bist du nah an unseren Kunden und am Markt. Du sprichst mit Stadtwerken und Industrieunternehmen über ihre technischen Herausforderungen, erkennst neue Projekte und entwickelst gemeinsam mit unseren Fachbereichen die passende Lösung.Dabei geht deine Aufgabe über klassischen Produktvertrieb hinaus.Du analysierst Märkte, identifizierst neue Anwendungsfelder und entscheidende Kunden, baust Netzwerke auf und entwickelst langfristige Geschäftsbeziehungen.Kurz gesagt: Du verkaufst nicht einfach ein Produkt. Du entwickelst mit uns einen Markt.Deine AufgabenDu entwickelst unser Geschäft mit Stadtwerken und Industriekunden in Süddeutschland strategisch weiter.Du identifizierst Marktpotenziale, Wachstumsfelder und neue Anwendungsbereiche für unsere Lösungen zur Abgasnachbehandlung.Du identifizierst relevante Zielkunden und sprichst potenzielle Neukunden aktiv an.Du gewinnst neue Kunden und entwickelst aus ersten Kontakten langfristige Geschäftsbeziehungen.Du betreust ausgewählte Kunden als Key Accounts und entwickelst die Zusammenarbeit kontinuierlich weiter.Du analysierst Kundenanforderungen und entwickelst gemeinsam mit unseren technischen Fachbereichen passende Lösungen.Du begleitest Projekte vom ersten Kundenkontakt über die technische und kaufmännische Abstimmung bis zum Abschluss.Du beobachtest Markt- und Kundenentwicklungen und bringst die daraus gewonnenen Erkenntnisse in unsere Vertriebsstrategie ein.Du baust ein belastbares Netzwerk aus Kunden, Partnern und relevanten Marktteilnehmern auf.Du entwickelst gemeinsam mit unserem Marketing geeignete Maßnahmen zur Marktbearbeitung und Geschäftsfeldentwicklung.Du bringst deine Markterfahrung in unser Vertriebsteam ein und unterstützt den internen Wissenstransfer.Das bringst du mitUns ist wichtiger, dass du Kunden und Märkte entwickeln kannst und unsere Technik verstehen möchtest, als ein vollkommen geradliniger Lebenslauf.Du hast eine kaufmännische oder technische Ausbildung oder ein entsprechendes Studium abgeschlossen.Du bringst idealerweise mehrere Jahre Erfahrung im technischen B2B-Vertrieb oder Vertriebsaußendienst mit.Erfahrungen mit Stadtwerken, Energieversorgern, Industrieunternehmen oder öffentlichen Auftraggebern sind ein Plus.Kenntnisse aus Energietechnik, Anlagenbau, Umwelttechnik, Abgasnachbehandlung oder verwandten technischen Märkten helfen dir beim Einstieg, sind aber kein Muss.Du hast Spaß an Neukundenakquise und Geschäftsentwicklung und wartest nicht darauf, dass Anfragen von allein kommen.Du verstehst technische und wirtschaftliche Zusammenhänge und kannst sie für unterschiedliche Ansprechpartner verständlich übersetzen.Du trittst sicher und verbindlich auf und bringst Verhandlungsgeschick sowie Abschlussstärke mit.Du arbeitest eigenständig und kannst ein größeres Vertriebsgebiet zuverlässig organisieren.Du gehst sicher mit CRM-Systemen und den gängigen Microsoft-Office-Anwendungen um.Du besitzt einen Führerschein der Klasse B und bringst Reisebereitschaft innerhalb Süddeutschlands mit.Du erfüllst nicht jeden Punkt? Deine Rolle
In dieser Rolle bist Du Teil unseres Produktentwicklungs-Teams. Bei uns arbeiten alle T-shaped: Jede:r hat eine klare Kernstärke und hilft auch über die eigene Rolle hinaus. Du bist neugierig auf Menschen und ihre Arbeit: Du willst wirklich verstehen, wie unsere Kund:innen und Partner arbeiten, und hast Lust, dafür auch mal in anderen Abteilungen mitzuarbeiten

title: Influencer und Social Media Lead (all genders)
description_clean:

Wenn ein Hund ein Problem hat, sucht sein Mensch nach einer Antwort. Mehrjährige Erfahrung in der Steuerung externer Produzent:innen, Freelancer oder Agenturen

title: Product Manager - Internal Tools and AI
description_clean:
Our mission
We're making Africa the first cashless continent.
In 2017, over half the population in Sub-Saharan Africa had no bank account. That's for good reason—the fees are too high, the closest branch can be miles away, and nobody takes cards. Without access to financial institutions, people are forced to keep their savings under the mattress. Small business owners rely on lenders who charge extortionate rates. Parents spend hours waiting in line to pay school fees in cash.
We're solving this by building financial services that just work: no account fees, instantly available, and accepted everywhere. In places where electricity, water and roads don't always work, you can still send money with Wave. In 2017, we launched a mobile app in Senegal for cash deposit, withdrawal, and peer-to-peer and business payments. Now, we have millions of users across 9 countries and are growing fast.
Our goal is to make Africa the first cashless continent and that's where you come in...How you'll help us achieve it
Every promise our products make to a user or merchant is kept by an internal team somewhere in the company. When those teams can organise their work, adapt quickly and stay focused, Wave moves fast; when they can't, the company slows down and customers feel it. When we were smaller, organizing work didn't take much more than a quick spreadsheet but that breaks at scale.
Wave is now the largest financial institution in Senegal, Côte d'Ivoire, and the Gambia. We work with millions of users every month, employ thousands of people, and are growing rapidly. Similar processes now run in a dozen countries, but each team has built its own version, either because they don't know a better one exists or because setting it up well is harder than it should be.
AI has made this both better and worse: anyone can now build a workflow in an hour, but many aren't secure, won't scale, cost too much, or automate a process that should have been simplified first. Your job is to think from first principles about how work at Wave should run, give people a consistent and safe way to improve their own workflows, and make the common ones easy to adopt.
We're looking for a product manager who gets a kick out of figuring out how work should actually flow, and who doesn't much care whether the answer is a tool we build, a workflow in something we already pay for, or no tool at all. Someone who enjoys getting into the weeds with operations teams and who turns what they learn there into playbooks and building blocks every team can use.
In this role, you'll...



Own how Wave's general work tools get used. You're accountable for tools like Slack, Monday, and AI serving teams well. You work with the People team and other stakeholders to make sure they're set up so that organizing work or finding an answer is easy from day one. You help us make the right calls on major vendor decisions using what you've seen first-hand from users.
Help operations teams use AI efficiently and safely. You find the use cases where it truly saves teams time and turn those into shared skills, bots, and templates others can pick up in minutes. You build with these tools every day and teach teams to build in a secure and affordable way.
Care about the person, but solve for the company. There are far more problems than you can take on, so you pick the ones that help the most teams. You turn each solution into a playbook, template, or building block, and work through champions in every team to carry it forward.
Make sure each problem gets solved the right way. You're the expert on how people organize work in general, but behind every workflow sits domain context, constraints, and sometimes a product tool that already fits. You work with the leaders and PMs in that domain to decide whether a process should be simplified, automated, or shouldn't exist at all.
Build the team this work needs, starting with you. In your first few months you'll spend much of your time in-country with our operations teams as an IC, setting up workflows yourself with Slack and Monday.com, creating Claude skills and writing the first playbooks. As you learn more about what the company needs you can help us form a team around you.

Remote team members are expected to travel to our operational markets (e.g. Senegal or Côte d'Ivoire) at least once per quarter. Exceptions apply, but we've found this key to understanding our users and product.

description_clean: Who we are ?Télécom Paris, part of the IMT (Institut Mines-Télécom) and a founding member of the Institut Polytechnique de Paris, is one of France's top 6 general engineering schools.The mainspring of Télécom Paris is to train, imagine and undertake to design digital models, technologies and solutions for a society and economy that respect people and their environment.Modern distributed systems are increasingly complex, with multiple interconnected components, services, and autonomous agents interacting in dynamic environments. Ensuring their cybersecurity requires analysing potential attacks, understanding the strategies available to attackers and defenders, and verifying that critical security properties are preserved. Formal verification provides rigorous methods for addressing these challenges, allowing engineers to reason about system behaviours and establish mathematical guarantees. However, applying these techniques to realistic systems remains challenging. Verification problems can involve large state spaces and complex strategic interactions, while constructing formal models and specifying security properties often requires specialised expertise.The VITAMIN-C (VerIficaTion of A MultI-ageNt system for Cybersecurity) project aims to address these challenges by combining formal verification with artificial intelligence. Building on VITAMIN, an existing modular model-checking platform for multi-agent systems, the project develops methods and tools for analysing cybersecurity properties in distributed and autonomous systems. Attackers and defenders are represented as agents with specific capabilities, objectives, and available actions. Their interactions are analysed using attack graphs, temporal and strategic logics, and model-checking techniques. The project also investigates how AI can improve the efficiency and accessibility of these verification processes.A central objective of VITAMIN-C is to integrate AI techniques into the verification workflow. On the computational side, AI models will be investigated to guide the exploration of large state spaces and prioritise promising verification strategies. By learning from previously verified models and their associated results, these components can help identify relevant search directions and reduce the computational effort required by verification algorithms. On the usability side, the project explores AI-assisted interfaces that support engineers in constructing formal models and specifying security properties. These interfaces may exploit natural-language processing and large language models to interpret engineering descriptions, suggest formal representations, and assist users throughout the verification process. In both cases, the correctness of verification results remains the responsibility of the underlying formal methods, which validate the outcomes produced or suggested by AI components.Within this context, the R&D engineer will contribute to the design, implementation, and evaluation of AI techniques for VITAMIN-C. The work will focus on developing AI components for verification guidance, investigating natural-language and LLM-based assistance for formal modelling, and integrating these capabilities into the existing platform. The engineer will also participate in the preparation of training and evaluation datasets, the development of experimental benchmarks, and the assessment of the proposed approaches in terms of effectiveness, computational efficiency, and reliability. The overall objective is to make formal verification more scalable and accessible while preserving the rigorous guarantees provided by the verification framework.Your main responsibilities will include :Carry out R&D work in artificial intelligence for formal verificationContribute to the research profile of Télécom Paris and Institut Mines-Télécom  The candidate must have a solid understanding of artificial intelligence, Python programming, data processing and analysis, and software engineering. title: Talent Acquisition Specialist - Operations & Supply Chain (m(w/d)
description_clean:

Idealerweise bringen Sie zudem Kenntnisse des regionalen Arbeitsmarkts in der Supply Chain mit.
Kommunikationsstärke und Organisationstalent zeichnen Sie ebenso aus wie eine strukturierte, eigenverantwortliche Arbeitsweise.
Sprachlich überzeugen Sie mit sehr guten Deutsch- sowie guten Englischkenntnissen in Wort und Schrift.

title: Vice President Finance (all genders)
description_clean:
Support us in designing the insurance experience of the future. As Vice President Finance (all genders), you will lead and further professionalise our global Finance function, ensuring the company has the financial transparency, processes, and steering mechanisms required to scale successfully.  
This role combines strategic financial leadership with hands-on ownership of all core finance activities, including financial planning, controlling, accounting, treasury, payroll, tax, reporting, and finance operations. You will lead a growing team and continue the transformation of Finance from a scale-up function into a mature, globally operating business partner.  
Beyond running the existing function, you will proactively identify future challenges and opportunities, helping leadership make well-informed decisions through robust planning, forecasting, business insights, and financial modeling. You will act as a trusted partner to the C-Level and leadership, and our corporate shareholder, ensuring Finance is not only a reporting function but a strategic driver of long-term success.
This is a full-time hybrid role, with 1-2 days per week working from our Berlin office.
Your Mission
Financial Leadership & Team Management

Lead, develop, and inspire the Finance team across all functional areas.
Manage and support direct reports, including Accounting, Controlling, and Finance Operations.
Build organisational capabilities, processes, and structures required for the next stage of growth.
Foster a high-performance culture focused on ownership, accuracy, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
Ensure appropriate resource planning and team development.

Financial Planning, Budgeting & Forecasting

Own the annual budgeting, forecasting, and long-range planning processes from a financial perspective.
Develop scalable planning structures and financial governance frameworks across all departments.
Ensure financial targets are translated into operational plans and measurable outcomes.
Continuously improve forecast quality and business visibility.
Support leadership with scenario planning and strategic decision-making.

Controlling & Business Partnering

Further develop financial controlling processes and management reporting.
Partner with department leaders to improve financial planning, cost transparency, and performance management.
Challenge assumptions, identify risks early, and provide actionable recommendations.
Establish a culture of financial accountability throughout the organisation.
Drive improvements in cost tracking, resource planning, and investment prioritisation.

Financial Reporting & Accounting

Ensure accurate and timely financial reporting across all entities and markets.
Oversee accounting, payroll, tax, treasury, and financial operations.
Ensure compliance with statutory, tax, and internal reporting requirements.
Manage month-end, quarter-end, and year-end closing processes.
Coordinate external audits and relevant financial reviews.

Corporate & Shareholder Finance

Serve as the primary financial interface to our corporate shareholder and relevant stakeholders.
Prepare board and shareholder reporting materials.
Support capital planning and long-term financial strategy.
Ensure transparency and professionalism in all financial communications.

Global Finance Operations

Own Finance processes across all markets.
Ensure consistency of financial standards and reporting across countries.
Support international expansion through scalable financial structures and processes.
Promote best-practice sharing and operational alignment across markets.

Finance Systems, Data & Automation

Drive the professionalisation and automation of Finance processes.
Improve the quality, availability, and utilisation of financial data.
Define requirements for Finance tooling, reporting, and workflow improvements.
Collaborate with Strategic Operations, Data, Product, and Engineering teams on automation initiatives.
Leverage technology and AI-enabled solutions to increase efficiency and decision quality.

Process Excellence & Continuous Improvement

Continuously evaluate and improve Finance processes, controls, and governance structures with a strong focus on simplicity and ease of use.
Reduce manual effort through standardisation and automation.
Implement scalable operating models that support company growth.
Ensure Finance remains fit for purpose as organisational complexity increases.

Requirements
What You Need to Succeed
Education:

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business Administration, or a related field.

Experience:

8+ years of experience in Finance, Controlling, FP&A, Accounting, or related fields.
Proven leadership experience in a scale-up, high-growth, or international environment.
Strong background in financial planning, forecasting, and business partnering.
Experience building and professionalising Finance functions and processes.
Exposure to corporate structures and shareholder reporting environments.
Experience in insurance, financial services, technology, or other regulated industries is beneficial.

Skills:

Strong analytical and strategic thinking capabilities.
Outstanding financial planning and modelling skills.
Strong stakeholder management and communication abilities.
Proven ability to influence decision-making at leadership level.
High degree of ownership and proactiveness.
Excellent organisational and prioritisation skills.
Strong understanding of finance systems, reporting structures, and process design.
Interest in automation, AI, and technology-enabled finance processes.

Full professional fluency (written and spoken) in English and German

title: Consultant SAP S/4HANA Transformation
description_clean: Für viele Unternehmen ist S/4HANA ein Pflicht-Upgrade. Bei UNITY ist es deine Mission, daraus eine echte unternehmerische Entscheidung für unsere Kunden zu machen: Wohin soll sich die Prozess- und Systemlandschaft bewegen? Was kostet welcher Weg und wer setzt ihn um? Und wie bleibt das Programm steuerbar? Du sitzt auf der Seite des Kunden. Du gestaltest End-to-End-Prozesse, Zielarchitektur und Programmsteuerung. title: Senior B2B Sales Manager
description_clean:
YOUR FUTURE, ON DEMAND
The ideal blend of stability and flexibility. A genuinely human employer that cares for people and the planet. True autonomy to shape what comes next, for us and you. This is the perfect platform to take your career where you want. 
Back in 2005, we pioneered Europe’s first TV streaming service. Today, we're a leading TV streaming provider with millions of monthly users, and since 2021 we've been ClimatePartner-certified. Over 200 colleagues of 47 nationalities. We’re the grown-up start-up, helping to shape a better future since day one.That hasn’t changed, even if the world has. We’re friendly, international, inclusive – and our people say we’re reliable and transparent, too. It’s why they trust us and believe in what we do.
THE ROLE
Make Zattoo the TV platform partner of choice for operators and broadcasters in Eastern and Northern Europe. This role turns new markets into lasting revenue and shapes Zattoo’s next stage of growth. You will join a close-knit team working across Germany and Switzerland that values trust, collaboration and hands-on ownership over hierarchy and heavy process.  
THE TEAM
The Zattoo Business Sales Team is responsible for all sales activities related to Zattoo’s TV-as-a-Service and streaming technology offerings, including the End-to-End TV platform as well as Modular products such as Streaming, Ingest and Orchestration solutions. We work closely with Product, Portfolio Management, Marketing, Client Success and Project Management to bring complex solutions to market and build long-term customer relationships across different regions and customer segments.
WHAT YOU’LL DO

Build a new business pipeline across Eastern and Northern Europe and win telcos, ISPs, broadcasters and OTT platforms as long-term customers
Own complex, high-value deals end-to-end, from first conversation to signed contract
Navigate long decision cycles and orchestrate our Sales Engineering, Product and Legal teams to get deals over the line
Build lasting relationships with senior decision makers up to C-level
Shape tailored offers from our modular platform (INGEST, STREAM, ORCHESTRATE, E2E)
Be Zattoo’s face in your markets, at customer meetings, trade shows and partner events, and bring market insights back to Product

WHAT YOU’LL BRING
Experience required (Must-have)

10+ years in B2B enterprise sales, closing complex deals with long sales cycles
Proven track record selling to telcos, broadcasters, media companies or platform providers
Deep understanding of the TV, OTT and streaming market
Established network in Eastern and/or Northern European markets
Confident negotiating with C-level and procurement teams
Business fluent English

Nice to have

Language skills in one or more Eastern or Northern European languages
Experience selling modular tech or SaaS platforms
German language skills are advantageous

Behavioural Competencies

Ownership: Takes full responsibility for their markets and deals, without relying on a large sales support machine.
Honest Forecasting: Reports pipeline and forecast realistically and transparently, including bad news early.
Team Player: Works closely with Product, Sales Engineering and Legal and values collaboration over individual heroics.
Hands-on Mentality: Comfortable building structures and materials themselves where needed.
Long-term Thinking: Builds relationships for the long run instead of chasing quick wins.

WHY JOIN US? 
At Zattoo, you’re always on firm ground with real freedom to explore. You’ll have the support and opportunity you need to go far, while you’re helping us create a sustainable and entertainment-filled future for all.
WHAT WE OFFER YOU

Reward: strong market competitive salary
Recharge: 30 days vacation plus public holidays
Regulate: trust based flexible working hours and the option for remote work worldwide for up to 8 weeks per year

Plus:

We’re sharing: Free access to the best streaming experience on the market
We're developing: Your own development budget, German classes and Zattoo all-company hack days
We’re inclusive: ‘Zattooies’ are a fun, engaged, and diverse team made up of 47 nationalities
We’re healthy: Health checks, mental wellbeing support, team sports and more!
We’re mobile: Discounted BVG tickets and free bike rentals
We’re sociable: A calendar of events with fireside chats, lunches, in-house bar, BBQ’s, monthly socials, summer party and an annual off-site event

title: Senior AI Specialist (Operations) (x/f/m)
description_clean: Doctolib is looking for you to join us as a Senior AI Specialist (x/f/m) at our Berlin location, starting as soon as possible.Doctolib is becoming an AI-native company. We are redesigning the way we work, workflow by workflow, and are looking for people who will not only support this transformation, but actively build it. As a Senior AI Specialist, you will be the technical builder and AI Ops Owner behind AI-powered productivity for our Operations and Customer Success teams. You will work in founder and product mode: you will own a workflow end to end, from context and agent design to evaluation, and continuously take it to a higher level of automation. Our ambition is to move away from manual case-by-case work towards workflows that run largely autonomously while maintaining a high quality bar. In this way, you will contribute directly to our mission of improving healthcare for everyone.Your ResponsibilitiesRedesign workflows rather than simply automating them: You analyze the most critical Operations and Customer Success workflows, break down time-consuming processes that require limited judgment, and transform them through the use of AI agents. You set clear objectives for autonomy and quality, and continuously develop them further.Build and operate AI agents as products: You develop and manage agents on platforms such as Dust or Claude. Each agent is deployed to production with a defined baseline and relevant metrics such as benefit, usage, and scalability.Knowledge and context management: You deliberately curate the context agents need, from templates to core data. The guiding principle is quality over quantity. You ensure that knowledge sources in Confluence, Drive, or Salesforce are always up to date and well structured.Evaluation and quality assurance: You define quality standards and establish evaluation routines to identify and address weaknesses such as hallucinations or prompt drift at an early stage. You continuously optimize prompts through systematic user feedback and A/B testing.CRM and data integration: You own the interfaces between CRM systems such as Salesforce and our AI platforms. You automate data flows and work closely with IT to unlock new, valuable data sources for our agents.Central interface and enablement: You translate business requirements into technical solutions and bring together stakeholders from Leadership, IT, and Product. You strengthen the team’s AI fluency in the areas of context, agent management, and evaluation.Impact and measurement: Rather than inventing new KPIs, you make the success of AI measurable using existing metrics such as time, quality, and cost, and use these insights to guide the next steps in scaling.Your ProfileSince production-ready AI workflows and agent technologies are still relatively new, years of market experience are rare. We therefore deliberately prioritize potential over years of experience alone. What matters to us is your ability to learn quickly, your strong product mindset, and your judgment. If you are passionate about this field and bring the necessary skills, we would be delighted to hear from you, even if your profile does not perfectly cover every single aspect.What Really Matters to Us, Regardless of the Specific Tool:Learning speed and a production mindset: You have taught yourself a new technical field from scratch and built something real that people actually used. You can describe precisely what went wrong, such as hallucinations, prompt drift, outdated data, or costs, and how you solved it.An instinct for evaluation: You do not rely on something merely “looking good”. You define a quality bar and measure against it. title: Senior Manager, Customer Support, Deliveroo Operations
description_clean:
About Wolt
At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we're building the delivery of (almost) everything and you'll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.Working at Wolt isn't always easy, but it's definitely exciting. Here you'll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You'll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you're a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.Our mission is to transform the way people shop and eat, connecting consumers, restaurants, shops, and riders to bring the neighbourhood to their door. We're redefining convenience by giving customers the ability to buy what they want, as they want it, when and where they want it.
Deliveroo is a technology-driven company at the forefront of one of the world's most dynamic industries. We are a relatively small team making a very large impact, moving fast, valuing ownership, and tackling some of the most interesting challenges in global commerce. We're driven by innovation, autonomy, and the ambition to deliver exceptional experiences for our customers, partners, and riders alike.
What You'll Be Doing
You will own frontline operational performance across two closely linked parts of Deliveroo's customer support network: an in-house Global Escalations team of around 50 agents based across the UK and Georgia, and the outsourced network delivering support on our behalf through three BPO partners and three Shared Service Centres, circa 1,500 agents across multiple locations, including the team leads and ops managers embedded within those outsourced functions.
Global Escalations sits at the heart of Deliveroo's most critical customer moments. The team manages our most sensitive, high-risk, and high-impact contacts, including complaints escalated to the Executive team. As the leader directly accountable for this recovery-focused centre of excellence, you will ensure the team operates with exceptional skill, judgement, and empathy, protecting Deliveroo's reputation, driving improvement through root cause analysis, and embedding a culture of integrity and customer-first recovery across the organisation.
For the outsourced network, you own how performance is delivered day to day, working closely with the team leads and ops managers embedded in each BPO and Shared Service Centre, not just the vendor relationship at arm's length. You own the operational rigour needed to make the network the best in class, from an experience and consistency perspective, across every market it supports.
Your key objective is to drive qualitative improvements to the customer experience, measured through CSAT, while balancing cost metrics like average handling time (AHT) and refund costs, rather than trading one off against the other. You will be the voice of Support to Deliveroo's market General Managers, taking full accountability for the Support experience in your markets, and you will partner closely with cross-functional Support & Operations teams, including Workforce Management, Training, Quality, and Policy, to drive initiatives that positively impact all three sides of the marketplace: customers, riders, and merchants.
You Will…

Own frontline operational performance delivered through the in-house Global Escalations team (UK and Georgia) and the outsourced network (3 BPOs, 3 Shared Service Centres, circa 1,500 agents), including the team leads and ops managers within those outsourced functions
Lead and develop the Global Escalations team directly, managing our most sensitive and reputation-critical contacts with judgement, empathy, and rigorous root cause analysis
Drive qualitative improvements to the customer experience, tracked through CSAT, while balancing cost metrics like AHT and refund costs
Act as the voice of Support to Deliveroo market GMs, taking full accountability for the Support experience in your markets and representing their priorities back into the function
Partner with Support & Operations cross-functional teams, including Workforce Management, Training, Quality, and Policy, to drive initiatives that improve the experience for customers, riders, and merchants
Design and run performance frameworks that hold BPO and SSC team leads and ops managers accountable for quality, SLA adherence, and CSAT, fostering a culture of partnership rather than pure oversight
Standardise processes and playbooks across outsourced partners and sites where it drives consistency, while respecting genuine market and site-specific differences
Diagnose and help bring down attrition and quality issues across the outsourced network, working with BPO and SSC leadership on the retention, engagement, and workforce planning changes needed
Partner with Product and Technology to shape the roadmap for customer support systems and channel strategy, identifying opportunities to enhance efficiency and automation across both in-house and outsourced teams
Build and maintain strong relationships with stakeholders across HR, Legal, and Policy to ensure service delivery evolves in line with business priorities
Drive data-informed improvement through analysis of contact drivers, escalation themes, and customer sentiment, translating insight into action for both Global Escalations and the outsourced network
Represent the function at relevant Weekly Business Reviews and senior forums, providing visibility on performance, risk, and recovery across both the in-house team and the outsourced network
Participate in the 24/7 Leadership Team on-call rota
Shape functional strategy and set OKRs for contact centre Support across Deliveroo markets, growing the remit from directing your own team to leading leaders, in line with DoorDash's Team Management career framework
Grow and develop the managers and leaders within your network, including Team Leads inside Global Escalations and the team leads and ops managers at each BPO and Shared Service Centre, building the next generation of people leaders

Our humble expectations

Extensive contact centre, BPO, or shared service centre leadership experience in a fast-paced, consumer-facing environment
Proven experience managing outsourced or vendor relationships at scale, including the team lead and ops manager layer embedded within partner organisations, not just the commercial relationship
Experience leading escalations or complaint handling in a reputation-sensitive environment, with strong judgement and the ability to drive recovery from the most sensitive customer moments
A track record of bringing consistency and governance across multiple outsourced partners while respecting genuine local and market differences
Experience diagnosing and reducing attrition while improving quality, in a large-scale, multi-site support operation
A data-driven approach to balancing customer experience (CSAT) against cost metrics such as AHT and refund rate, without trading one off blindly against the other
Experience representing a support or operations function to senior commercial stakeholders, such as General Managers or market leadership, taking full accountability for their experience of the function
Experience partnering with cross-functional teams such as Workforce Management, Training, Quality, and Policy to drive improvements across a multi-sided marketplace
Exceptional stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to influence senior leaders and work cross-functionally with Product, Legal, Policy, and People teams
Strong analytical ability, comfortable turning contact driver, escalation, and sentiment data into action
Strong people leadership skills, with experience building and developing a dispersed in-house team and driving performance indirectly through partner leadership
A self-starter mindset, a can-do attitude, and willingness to be hands-on in a fast-moving, multi-geography environment
Proven strategic mindset with a track record of shaping and executing operational strategies across multiple markets and vendors
Deep operational understanding, including customer service design, vendor management, and process optimisation
Demonstrated ability to deliver results in high-volume, complex environments with multiple priorities
Experience partnering with Product and Tech to drive tooling, system, and automation improvements
A mindset focused on continuous improvement, customer advocacy, and operational excellence
Demonstrated ability to operate at a 'leads leaders' level per DoorDash's Levels and Expectations framework (Team Management track): shaping strategy and OKRs beyond your own team, and developing managers who in turn develop their own teams
Meets the senior people-leadership bar DoorDash expects at this level: effectively leads a high-performing team, fosters a culture of belonging and engagement, and takes full accountability for the people outcomes of a large, dispersed organisation

We're committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities.
